YOU’RE RUNNING A FICTIONAL RESTAURANT.

What would you change?

SIMULATED MONTHLY PROFIT$3,400
Starting scenario
Revenue$15,000
Ingredients + waste$6,600
Fixed costs$5,000

Each percentage point of waste costs $60 per month in this scenario.

See the assumptions & math

Illustrative inputs only—not Red Pepper or Habibi Tacos data. Selling price is $15 per order, with $5,000 in monthly fixed costs. Profit = orders × $15 − orders × ingredient cost × (1 + waste rate) − $5,000. Waste is modeled as an added ingredient cost. This simplified model excludes taxes, variable labor, fees, and other costs.
